## Problem

Describe the failure or requested behavior. Include the relevant scope approval.

## Change

Explain how the change solves that problem and why edits across packages belong together.

## Verification

List the focused commands or manual checks, environment and observed results.
For CLI changes, include sanitized output. Link visual evidence when relevant.

## Limits

State what is untested, what remains incomplete, and any operational risks.
Keep local, hosted, installed-package, native and live claims separate.

If an agent contributed, name its model and harness.
